entities.name: EPS bearer context modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure for modifying an existing EPS bearer context between UE and network.

entities.name: MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by network to UE to request modification of EPS bearer context parameters.

entities.name: MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by UE to network to accept the EPS bearer context modification.

entities.name: MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by UE to network to reject the EPS bearer context modification.

entities.name: EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Identifies the EPS bearer context to be modified.

entities.name: New QoS parameters
entities.description: Contains the modified QoS parameters for the EPS bearer context.

entities.name: Traffic flow template
entities.description: Defines packet filters for the EPS bearer context.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: UE must be in EMM-REGISTERED state to perform EPS bearer context modification.

relations.description: Procedure starts with network sending MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.
Procedure continues with UE sending MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT message if modification is accepted.
Procedure continues with UE sending MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message if modification is rejected.
MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message contains EPS bearer identity IE.
MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message contains new QoS parameters IE.
MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message may contain traffic flow template IE.
EPS bearer context modification procedure requires UE to be in EMM-REGISTERED state.
